root_cause: The revenue-learning-store edge function bounds every database call to 2.5 seconds. On a cold start the first query of the hourly revenue-learning-evaluate run exceeded that bound, the gateway received 503 'TimeoutError: Signal timed out' and the whole run failed (14:00:51 UTC on 2026-10-27, 4.7 s); only the platform retry at 14:00:56 completed (204, 8.8 s).
prevention: The Netlify gateway retries one time after a 400 ms pause on a 5xx or network failure. Every action is a read or carries an idempotency key, so the retry cannot duplicate writes. 4xx responses and degraded 202 payloads are never retried.

evidence.runtime_status: unverified until Netlify logs show the hourly revenue-learning-evaluate first attempt without 503 after a cold start

limitations: One retry only; a store that stays slow still fails the run, visibly
The 2.5 s store bound in the edge function is unchanged
